events.use_of_proceeds: Design and simulation of innovative p-11B targets for IFE

notes: INFUSE awards (in-kind lab-access vouchers; no dollar amount is published on the awards listing) from the ORNL INFUSE awards listing pages archived by the ledger-infuse/ledger-commonwealth-fusion-systems runs (infuse.ornl.gov/awards/ and /page/N). The listing gives project title, cycle, award date, company and host lab/university; the date shown is taken as announced_on. Vouchers are not cash and must not be summed with funding. VERIFIER: Recipient on the INFUSE listing is HB11 Energy USA LLC (US subsidiary); host is the University of Rochester. INFUSE awards pay the host lab or university to do work for the company (in-kind, no cash to the company; D5: lab/university money is not company funding). Kept as amount-less voucher events for context only; they never count toward raised totals and do not by themselves satisfy D1.
